review_focus: The env-secret-guard change: core .skilled/hooks/env-secret-guard/lib/env-secret-guard.cjs, its runtime adapters (Claude, Codex, Cursor, Devin, Pi, DSH, OpenCode plugin), the hook-registry entry, CE-P06/CE-P07 playbook scenarios and the docs that list it. Hunt for dotenv reads or writes the guard misses, false denials, value leaks from the inspection tools, and doc claims the code does not back. Never open a real .env file.
findingsSummary: One command-substitution dotenv-read bypass and two false-denial cases.

findingDetails.title: Command-substitution path assignment can read .env without refusal
findingDetails.scopeProof: Direct shell readers are within packet scope.

findingDetails.title: Single-quoted variable reference is expanded and falsely denied
findingDetails.scopeProof: Quoted shell-reader arguments are handled by the classifier.

findingDetails.title: .env* is denied when only the exempt .env.example exists
findingDetails.scopeProof: The core defines .env.example as an exempt template.

traceabilityChecks.notes: Three shell edge cases are not tested.
Direct/fallback paths and a glob with a real .env fixture are covered.
Scenario docs reviewed; live runtime scenarios not executed.

integrationEvidence.claim: Registry names Claude, Codex, Cursor, Devin, and Pi registrations.
Named adapters delegate tool decisions to shared core.
CE-P06 documents scratch fixtures and canary-history checks.
CE-P07 documents edit refusal and .env.example follow-up.

ruledOut: Direct cat .env and f=.env; cat "$f" are covered by core tests.
Patch-looking write content does not select a dotenv target.
edgeCases: Graph bootstrap/upsert not run because its target-spec write path exceeds lineage-only scope.
noveltyJustification: The lineage registry was empty; all three findings are new.
